text:
DeployBot: INCIDENT ALERT: p99 latency breach detected for /v1/generate in us-west-2 - threshold 2.5s exceeded (p99=3.9s) :rotating_light:

Alice (oncall): paging - I'm on it. pulling up dashboards now.

Carla (observability): I see a sudden jump ~08:03 UTC across streaming and non-streaming routes, tail at ~12s on some hosts. Rolling host list looks correlated to node group rg-infer-4.

Ben (runtime): any recent rollout? configs?

Paul (prod-eng): small canary pushed ~07:50 - model-variants: v2 -> v2-quant. Could that be related?

Alice (oncall): good call, checking rollout history...

Carla (observability): dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/latency/live?panel=p99&region=us-west-2 - spike starts ~08:02, CPU on those GPUs low though, but GPU memory shows increased evictions.

Ben (runtime): evictions -> KV cache thrash maybe. Are we seeing more unique prefixes?

MetricsBot: aggregate logs: region=us-west-2 route=/v1/generate p95=1.1s p99=3.9s streaming_stall_count=127

Jess (support): customer impact check: top 5 customers in region report slow responses, one reported client-side timeouts at 10s. Notified CS leads.

Alice (oncall): quick mitigation options: a) rollback canary b) route traffic away from rg-infer-4 to rg-infer-2 (capacity available) c) enable degraded mode: reduce max_tokens limit for streaming to 512. Thoughts?

Paul (prod-eng): immediate fallback to rg-infer-2 seems safest, minimal config change. Start moving 30% traffic now and watch.

Ben (runtime): prepping routing change. applying policy: route policy id=route-tilt-2023 with weights {rg-infer-4:70, rg-infer-2:30}. command: ``/infra route update --policy route-tilt-2023 --weights us-west-2:rg-infer-2=30``

Alice (oncall): applying now.

DeployBot: ROUTE UPDATE: policy route-tilt-2023 applied at 08:10 UTC by Alice.

Carla (observability): new metrics: p99 dropping to 2.7s within 60s after reroute. streaming_stall_count stabilizing but still elevated.

Ben (runtime): still seeing KV cache misses on rg-infer-4. Could be a memory leak in the quantized kernel path. I'll scale rg-infer-4 down and disable quant variant for new traffic.

Paul (prod-eng): go for it. keep scaling conservative to avoid capacity crunch.

Alice (oncall): scaling down 2 instances from rg-infer-4 and marking quant variant as disabled for auto-routing.

MetricsBot: scaling action recorded, quant_variant=disabled on rg-infer-4 at 08:14 UTC.

Carla (observability): p99 now at 1.9s across the region. streaming stalls dropping to single digits per minute.

Jess (support): raising incident severity to P1 due to customer timeouts; CS triage in progress.

Alice (oncall): summary for postmortem notes: root suspected: quantized kernel path in canary caused increased KV cache evictions leading to tail stalls; immediate mitigation: traffic reroute to rg-infer-2 and disable quant variant; next steps: reproduce locally, collect heap/gpu-mem traces from affected hosts, rollback or patch kernel.

Ben (runtime): I'll grab traces and open a dedicated bug with logs + coredump. tagging eng-ml.

Paul (prod-eng): schedule a 30-min follow-up huddle at 08:45 UTC to decide permanent rollback and customer-impact comms.

Alice (oncall): oncall handoff note: if incident remains elevated at shift end, escalate to Ben on next rotation.

DeployBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity=P1; mitigation=reroute/disable-quant; status=stabilized; timestamp=08:20 UTC.

Jess (support): customers notified with ETA for permanent fix TBD. will update with incident postmortem link after write-up. :white_check_mark:
